name: Block-internal n-1 / n+1
notes: Enters with the purchased blocks, NOT at ligation: it is created in block synthesis and no filtration mode removes a single-nucleotide deletion, so the DS full-length ceiling is purity_floor() (EQ-PURITY, P-BLOCK-PUR, P-N-BLOCKS). ~5% fragment-internal carry-through observed (SRC-NATCOMM-2024). Note R-018: the non-full-length remainder is NOT all internal deletions - capping converts coupling failures into truncations, a more tractable class. See Q-011.

name: Unreacted blocks and partial ligation products
notes: Unreacted blocks arrive with the feed; partial ligation products are created at ligation, sized ~ (1 - P-LIG-CONV). They differ from product by a whole block so UF/DF clears them, but no oligo-specific clearance number exists - carried as a gap. See Q-036, R-011.

name: Adenylylated dead-end (AppN)
notes: Observed as the [+AMP] by-product in fully modified siRNA blockmer ligation (SRC-ALMAC-2023). NOT equivalent to the splint: the splint is genuinely absent by design, whereas suppressing AppN is a proposed reaction restaging (R-010) that is NOT demonstrated for this process, and the ATP requirement pulls against the concentration that suppresses it (Q-040). Residual at drug substance is therefore an open gap, not a solved problem.

name: ATP / AMP / PPi / monovalent salts
notes: The diafiltration workhorse: cleared to a residual of exp(-N) at N = P-DF-DIAVOL diavolumes ASSUMING a sieving coefficient near 1 (EQ-DIAF, SRC-PALL-TFF). That assumption is the caveat - these are polyvalent anions in a polyanion stream, and the divalent row below is the direct counterexample to sieving ~1 for a charge-interacting species. See Q-020.

name: Divalent cations (Mg2+ / Ca2+)
notes: Enters with the ligation buffer, which carries MgCl2 (BUF-LIG). Binds the polyanion and resists diafiltration, so it does not behave like the monovalent salts above; residual is a gap (R-014).

name: Ligase protein
notes: Removed by clarification/centrifugation only if the enzyme is immobilised; no residual-protein clearance (ppm or log) number exists anywhere in the public record (R-002, Q-032). A cell-free-extract route raises the burden to a whole proteome (R-017).

name: Splint oligo
intro_stream: S04 (only if a foreign splint is used)
cleared_by: designed out (complementary strand is the splint)
notes: For siRNA the complementary product strand acts as the splint, so there is genuinely nothing foreign to remove (R-006). This is a real absence, unlike AppN above, whose suppression is proposed but undemonstrated.

name: Endotoxin (LPS micelles)
notes: Enters with water and reagents, not at ligation. Co-retained with product by UF; an adsorber alone left 641 EU/mg against a competing polyanion and reached specification only with an orthogonal NaOH step (R-007). Residual is a gap and the DS limit is dose-derived (Q-037).

name: Aggregates / particulates / bioburden
intro_stream: S03 + S04 (and every open handling step)
notes: Cleared by depth and 0.2 um filtration; the bioburden target is <1 CFU/mL at DS (SRC-PMC7415879). See Q-037.
